speed_settings.title: Speed settings
speed_settings.sub_text:
Enter speed number between 0.1 and 10
The speed setting will only affect the time interval between actions,
this will not affect other settings that are time related.
speed_settings.error_new_value: Your speed value must be between 0.1 and 10!

repeat_settings.title: Repeat settings
repeat_settings.error_new_value: You cannot have less than 1 repetition.

delay_settings.title: Delay settings
delay_settings.error_new_value: You cannot have less than 0 delay.

randomized_delay_settings.title: Randomized delay settings
randomized_delay_settings.sub_text:
Configure randomized delay bounds between actions in milliseconds.
Values below zero will allow for decreased time to next action.
Values above zero will allow for increased time to next action.
randomized_delay_settings.error_new_value: Both randomized delay bounds must be valid numbers.

distribution_drawer_settings.title: Distribution Editor
distribution_drawer_settings.distribution_instruction_text:
Draw the curve to represent how often each value is chosen.
Horizontal axis is the configured numerical range; vertical axis is relative frequency.
distribution_drawer_settings.help_instructions_text: Draw/edit with the mouse 1 button • Drag green points • Erase with mouse 2 button • Mouse wheel to zoom

vertical.tooltip_text: Higher values mean that the corresponding X values are chosen more often.

horizontal.tooltip_text: The horizontal axis maps from the lower bound to the upper bound.

settings_information.preset_tooltip_text: Presets create starting states. Freehand preserves the current curve.
settings_information.interpolate_tooltip_text: Controls how sparse stored points are interpreted between their X coordinates.
settings_information.interpolate_button_tooltip_text: Fill gaps in the current drawing using the selected interpolation mode.
settings_information.clear_tooltip_text: Remove the entire curve/drawing. This is separate from right-drag erasing, which removes only the selected area.
settings_information.zoom_tooltip_text: Zoom changes only the graph viewport. It never changes normalized distribution data.

freehand.note_text: Does not change the existing curve.

linear.description_text: Flat uniform distribution. Starts as two points at the two extremes in the middle of the vertical axis.

curve_generation.description_text: Generate a smooth bell shaped curve normal-style starting curve, then edit it freely.
curve_generation.note_text: Generator settings are not applied until Generate / Apply is pressed.

curve_generation.center_tooltip_text: Center of a single generated peak or the center around which multiple peaks are arranged.
curve_generation.width_tooltip_text: Controls the width of generated peaks. Larger values create broader curves.
curve_generation.height_tooltip_text: Controls the relative amplitude (height) of generated peaks before vertical normalization.
curve_generation.tail_tooltip_text: Changes how quickly the selected tail falls away from the peak.
curve_generation.asymmetry_tooltip_text: Positive values broaden the right side; negative values broaden the left side.
curve_generation.peaks_tooltip_text: Use one or more independently configurable smooth peak components.
curve_generation.peak_tooltip_text: Each peak can be customized independently. Center, width, height, and asymmetry are percentages.
curve_generation.generate_tooltip_text: Replace the current editor curve with the generated curve using the current generator settings.
curve_generation.reset_tooltip_text: Restore the curve generator settings to the default. Does not alter the existing curve.
curve_generation.empty_peaks_text: No peaks are generated when the peak count is zero.
curve_generation.input_error_text: Errors have been found in the following inputs:

error.invalid_distribution_text: The current distribution is not valid and cannot be applied.
error.invalid_generator_text: One or more generator values are invalid. Please enter finite numbers in the allowed ranges.
